purpose: Convert repeated failures and expensive trajectories into validated lessons, skills, guardrails or tooling changes.
rules: Do not promote a lesson without evidence.
Compress falsified hypotheses and prevent their reuse without new evidence.
Prefer converting stable repeated lessons into deterministic tooling.
For 3D vehicle incidents, prove asset-forward, physical-forward and conversion ownership before recommending physics changes.
Treat validator crashes before assertions as INCONCLUSIVE and separate environment failures from candidate failures.
Distinguish failed reads from mismatched values before reporting cache, manifest or hash corruption.
